<context_for_action>
The task explicitly requires "checks that catch cases of non-log-concave densities during the sampling process" - it's stated twice in the requirements. Disabling check_log_concavity entirely violates this requirement. 

The fundamental approach change needs to fix the false positive issue while still providing log-concavity detection. Consider: distance-weighted tolerance that scales with |x_new - x[i]|, or checking only against closest tangent lines rather than all segments, or deferring the check until after several iterations when hulls are better refined.
</context_for_action>
